name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Ultrafast quantum gate operations in a Kramers-Henneberger atom Qubit
items.dek: Kramers-Henneberger atom qubits demonstrate femtosecond single-qubit gates, six orders of magnitude faster than superconducting platforms.
items.unproven: scaling to multi-qubit gates, practical fabrication and control engineering, noise and leakage suppression in hardware implementations

items.title: Exploring the Relaxation Landscape of a 2D Quantum Magnet on a 256-Qubit Processor
items.dek: 256-qubit Rydberg array maps relaxation regimes in 2D Ising model, identifying prethermal and slowdown phases beyond thermalization.
items.unproven: whether results hold at larger scales or different Hamiltonians, classical simulation complexity claims need independent verification

items.title: Ransomware gangs skip the CEO, head straight for the 40-something IT manager
items.dek: Ransomware operators target mid-level IT staff over executives; social engineering tactic, not technical discovery.
items.unproven: Whether this represents a shift in attacker behavior or reporting bias; no empirical prevalence data across threat intel sources.

items.title: Shopify replaced Redis with MySQL for inventory reservations–and it scaled
items.dek: Shopify migrated inventory reservation logic from Redis to MySQL; architectural choice specific to their scale and schema.
items.unproven: whether the tradeoffs generalize beyond Shopify's specific workload, schema, and operational maturity.

items.title: Managing AI Coding Costs at Scale
items.dek: Databricks cost-management patterns for AI coding tools; establishes vocabulary around token budgets and batching.
items.unproven: applicability beyond Databricks' own infrastructure and use cases; no independent validation of claims

items.title: Demonstration of an LLO CV-QKD system over 12 km of optical fiber
items.authors: Christiano M. S. Nascimento et al.
items.dek: CV-QKD system with independent transmitter and receiver lasers demonstrates 5.11 Mbit/s key rates over 12 km fiber.
items.unproven: Post-quantum migration planning is on the reader's roadmap, but this is a physics demonstration of one QKD variant, not a deployment risk assessment or migration pathway; no assessment of when or whether this replaces current key exchange in financial infrastructure.

items.title: Observation of far-from-equilibrium scaling in the transient dynamics of 2D quantum magnets
items.dek: Rydberg-atom arrays show mean-field scaling in quench dynamics across multiple 2D lattice geometries.
items.unproven: Quantum simulation on analog hardware does not inform application security, secure SDLC, or agent governance in financial services.

items.title: The web server deployment model breaks at hobby scale
items.dek: Discussion of web server deployment model constraints at small scale.
items.unproven: specific architectural or security implications for the reader's tooling and SDLC process

items.title: Docker Sandboxes – Disposable, isolated sandboxes for AI agents
items.dek: Docker-based sandboxing for AI agents; Docker marketing announcement, practical relevance unclear without methodology detail.
items.unproven: whether isolated containers adequately constrain agent behavior in SDLC pipelines; security properties unspecified

items.title: An Analysis of Architectural and Operational Dynamics of Phishkits in the Wild
items.dek: Analysis of 1,300 phishkits from 2020–2023 finds 22% lack evasion, most rely on messaging services for data exfiltration.
items.unproven: does not establish how findings apply to phishkit prevalence or attacker behavior outside the collected corpus

items.title: An Exploratory Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Rewriting of Moderate-Complexity Financial Sentences for DisCoCat-Based Sentiment Analysis
items.dek: LLM-assisted sentence rewriting improves quantum NLP circuit efficiency on financial sentiment; niche application with marginal gains.
items.unproven: whether modest accuracy improvements (0.550 vs 0.521) hold on production financial data or generalize beyond sentiment classification

items.title: QMIMO: Circuit Based Quantum MIMO Design with Variational Receiver
items.dek: Quantum circuit receiver for MIMO channels underperforms classical detectors; experimental quantum communications without security implication.
items.unproven: whether trade-offs hold at scale or justify quantum approach for any practical communication task

items.title: Origin of Long-Lived Nuclear Spin States and Coherences in Aliphatic Chains Revealed by Relaxation Theory
items.dek: Long-lived nuclear spin states in aliphatic chains arise from zero-eigenvalue subspaces of the relaxation superoperator.
items.unproven: NMR physics is outside the reader's remit; no connection to application security, SDLC tooling, or secure code practices.

items.title: Existence of Kraus decomposition in infinite dimension via strongly-convergent direct process tomography
items.dek: Constructive algorithm for Kraus decomposition of completely positive operators in infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces with strong-operator convergence.
items.unproven: Quantum information theory has no practical bearing on the reader's SDLC tooling, code review process, or secure architecture decisions.

items.title: Atomic correlation effects in collapse-induced spontaneous radiation
items.dek: Atomic structure effects modulate spontaneous radiation rates predicted by collapse models, enabling model discrimination.
items.unproven: Fundamental physics testing is outside the reader's domain; no relevance to application security, agent governance, or post-quantum migration planning.
